caption: The drawing consists of three outlined views of an armchair rendered primarily in black ink on a beige or off-white background. The three views are a front view, a side view, and a top-down profile of an armrest, all placed within a rectangular border. In the front view, the chair has ornate, curved armrests and decorative details in the back splat and legs; one leg displays an elaborate carved motif. The front view includes measurements, such as 25 3/8 inches, 33 1/2 inches, and 19 3/4 inches, marked in fine brownish-red lines. The side view reveals a curved seatback, a flat seat, and cabriole legs ending in carved feet, also annotated with precise dimensions, including 43 3/4 inches for height and 23 1/4 inches for depth. The partial view in the upper left corner illustrates the curved profile of one armrest. The upper middle of the page contains the text "ARMCHAIR SCALE 8 IN-TO 11IN." All drawing lines and annotations are clean and technical in appearance, with the scale and detailed measurements carefully indicated in both black and red ink. There are no additional objects or backgrounds; the illustration is focused solely on the structure and dimensions of the armchair.
title: Arm Chair
